spec.headline: The Liquidity Choke Point
spec.subhead: Secondary exchange depth constrains pooled liquidation solvency.

blocks.text: Blend lending TVL against $1,238,140 in Soroswap AMM liquidity
When secondary market depth is thin relative to total debt, shared pools risk shortfall dilution across depositors.

focal.reason: The $157.2M lending pool TVL immediately establishes the scale disparity against secondary AMM depth.

defects.issue: Severe bottom-heavy dead space causing vertical imbalance
defects.reason: The entire text and stat stack terminates around y=660px, leaving over 400px of dead negative space at the bottom while the top padding is only ~120px. This creates an ungrounded, top-heavy composition.
defects.fix: Shift the entire content group down by 140px, or vertically center the entire stack within the 1080px canvas to balance top and bottom margins.

defects.issue: Insufficient contrast on supporting body copy
defects.location: Bottom body paragraph ('When secondary market depth is thin...')
defects.reason: The body copy uses a dark muted slate tone that blends into the near-black background, falling below acceptable legibility thresholds for social feeds.
defects.fix: Increase the body copy brightness to at least #A5A1B2 or rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72) to ensure readable contrast against the ground.
